note:
WRITTEN BY HAND 2026-10-15 from discover run 38666680395, which dumped the whole GetBidsList body (8,105 bytes, lastUpdated 2026-10-15T01:39:18Z; kept as fixtures/bushel-synergy.json), and bushel probe run 38666683015. synergycooperative.com is parked and synergycoop.com/markets/cash.php and synergycoop.o.bushelsites.com/cash-bids load no board (discover run 38666385433); their Bushel portal, https://portal.bushelpowered.com/synergy/cash-bids, does. It answers 20 rows across five locations: Almena Grain, Cameron Grain, Elk Mound Grain, Rice Lake Grain, Ridgeland Grain -- corn and soybeans, "New Crop '26" against ZCZ26/ZSX26 and "Jan '27" against ZCH27/ZSF27. locationId is the UUID the payload carries for "Rice Lake Grain"; the town is the board's own name minus "Grain", and Synergy Community Cooperative holds a Wisconsin warehouse licence at each of these five towns (data/registries.json, registry-wcmd). No Chetek board is posted, though Synergy is licensed there.

CASH ROUNDING, MEASURED on the whole board over two days (lib/rounding.mjs roundingEvidence). 2026-10-15 (fixtures/bushel-synergy.json, 20 rows): floor-cent and round-cent-either both explained every row, residuals 0, 0.25 and 0.5c only -- ambiguous, so the board was held disabled. 2026-10-16 (bushel probe run 38961338857, 20 rows across the same five locations, 4 each): floor-cent explains 20 of 20, round-cent-either 15, round-cent 10, exact 0; residuals 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75c, none negative. The 0.75c rows (one per location) rule out round-cent-either. Both days together: floor-cent 40 of 40, round-cent-either 35, round-cent 25, exact 10. Verdict floor-cent, margin 5 -- the eighths remainder of the futures quote, the same signature River Country's board (same platform) settled on. The probe called each location TOO FEW TO STATE only because each has 4 rows of its own; across the board the margin is 5. A wrong mode makes the board refuse loudly on the next read rather than publish a misread price.

PLACE: the centroid of ZIP 54868 (Rice Lake), from the licence row in geocodes/places.json. Town precision; no street address is published that this repository holds.
publicNote: Their publicly posted cash board, read from the same Bushel feed their own customer portal reads. Cash and basis are their own commercial numbers. The futures quote is carried only so a consumer can re-check cash minus basis; it is not redistributed as a price feed.
